newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong sends home 234 Vietnamese boatpeople.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong sends home 234 Vietnamese boatpeople.

text.p: Hong Kong sent 243 Vietnamese boatpeople home on two repatriation flights on Tuesday in its drive to clear out all failed aslyum seekers ahead of the territory's 1997 handover to China.
Most of the returnees -- 103 men, 60 women, 80 children -- had been incarcerated in detention camps since they arrived in the British colony in 1990, the government said.
The latest repatriation flights reduced the number of Vietnamese detainees in Hong Kong down to 7,349, a security branch spokeswoman said.
China resumes sovereignty over Hong Kong at midnight next June 30, and has insisted that the colonial administration must empty the boatpeople camps before the handover.
The detainees are the last of a huge exodus of people who fled Vietnam, mostly by boat, after the communists won the war there in 1975.
